# AniNexus REST API (v1)

> AniNexus is a high-performance, 100% free and open-source Anime Metadata, Media & Ecosystem REST API. It aggregates verified multi-season anime franchise timelines, verified dual global community consensus ratings, localized audio dubbing matrices (Hindi, English, Japanese, etc.), live broadcast schedules, real-time industry news feeds, and a curated 5-year rolling Anime Awards vault.

- **API Architecture:** RESTful Web API (v1)
- **Base URL:** `https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1`
- **Root Documentation:** `https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/`
- **Health Check:** `https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/health`
- **Frontend Portal:** `https://aninexus-api-website.pages.dev`
- **Authentication:** None required! 100% Free, Public & Open.
- **CORS:** Enabled (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) for all browser and web applications.
- **Format:** JSON (`application/json; charset=utf-8`)
- **Default Rate Limit:** 90 requests / minute per IP with standard HTTP 429 backoff headers.
- **Future Roadmap:** GraphQL interface and WebSocket real-time broadcast streams are planned for future major releases.

---

## Core Distinguishing Features

1. **Franchise-First Unified Timelines:** Unlike standard APIs that fragment every season into disjointed entries, AniNexus links all parts (seasons, movies, OVAs, specials) of 634+ master franchises into chronological watch-order timelines.
2. **Dual-Score Consensus Engine:** Blends dual global community rating scales into a balanced, verified consensus score.
3. **Multilingual Dub Matrix:** Directly provides verification flags for localized dubs including Hindi (`hasHindiDub`), English (`hasEnglishDub`), Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, and Japanese.
4. **5-Year Rolling Awards Retention:** Curates official Industry Anime Awards from 2021 to 2026. Queries for years older than 5 years (e.g. 2020) strictly return HTTP 410 Gone per automated data retention policy.
5. **Intelligent News & Editorial Routing:** Automatically syncs verified global anime press & media feeds; items with images are routed to `/api/v1/news`, while text-only editorials route to `/api/v1/articles` with a 60-day TTL auto-purge.

---

## Complete REST API Endpoints Reference

### 1. System Health
- **`GET /health`**
  - Description: Real-time service uptime, process status, and ISO timestamp.
  - Query Params: None
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/health`

### 2. Top Curated Collections
- **`GET /api/v1/top`**
  - Description: Leaderboards across trending, popular, rated, movies, and currently airing titles.
  - Query Params:
    - `type` (string, optional, default: `"trending"`): One of `trending`, `popular`, `rated`, `movies`, `airing`.
    - `page` (number, optional, default: `1`): Pagination page number.
    - `limit` (number, optional, default: `20`): Items per page (max `50`).
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/top?type=popular&limit=5"`

### 3. Seasonal Broadcast Hub
- **`GET /api/v1/seasons/now`**
  - Description: Anime airing in the current broadcast season with dual scores and dub info.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/seasons/now`
- **`GET /api/v1/seasons/upcoming`**
  - Description: Upcoming anime queued for next broadcast cycles.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/seasons/upcoming`
- **`GET /api/v1/seasons/:year/:season`**
  - Description: Historical seasonal archive.
  - Path Params:
    - `year` (number, e.g. `2024`)
    - `season` (string: `winter`, `spring`, `summer`, `fall`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/seasons/2024/fall`

### 4. Anime Awards Engine (5-Year Rolling Window: 2021–2026)
- **`GET /api/v1/awards`**
  - Description: Award window metadata and available ceremony years.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/awards`
- **`GET /api/v1/awards/latest`**
  - Description: Latest ceremony winners and nominees (2026 edition).
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/awards/latest`
- **`GET /api/v1/awards/:year`**
  - Description: Award winners & nominees by year. Note: Requesting years < 2021 triggers `410 Gone`.
  - Path Params:
    - `year` (number, e.g. `2026`, `2025`, `2024`, `2023`, `2022`, `2021`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/awards/2026`
- **`GET /api/v1/awards/category/:categorySlug`**
  - Description: Historical timeline of nominees and winners for a specific award category.
  - Path Params:
    - `categorySlug` (string, e.g. `anime-of-the-year`, `best-animation`, `best-action`, `best-score`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/awards/category/anime-of-the-year`

### 5. Master Franchise Vault
- **`GET /api/v1/series/:slug`**
  - Description: Full master franchise dossier with consolidated metadata, dub flags, ratings, and parts.
  - Path Params:
    - `slug` (string, e.g. `attack-on-titan`, `solo-leveling`, `jujutsu-kaisen`, `frieren-beyond-journeys-end`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/series/attack-on-titan`
- **`GET /api/v1/series/:slug/timeline`**
  - Description: Chronological watch-order timeline parts for the franchise.
  - Path Params:
    - `slug` (string)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/series/attack-on-titan/timeline`
- **`GET /api/v1/series/:slug/episodes`**
  - Description: Consolidated episode directory with filler/canon classifications.
  - Path Params:
    - `slug` (string)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/series/attack-on-titan/episodes`
- **`GET /api/v1/anime/:idOrSlug`**
  - Description: Single season or film metadata by standard Anime ID or slug.
  - Path Params:
    - `idOrSlug` (string or number, e.g. `52991` or `attack-on-titan`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/anime/52991`
- **`GET /api/v1/anime/:idOrSlug/languages`**
  - Description: Dedicated audio dub and subtitle language availability matrix.
  - Path Params:
    - `idOrSlug` (string or number)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/anime/attack-on-titan/languages`

### 6. Search & Taxonomy Filters
- **`GET /api/v1/search`**
  - Description: Typo-tolerant omni-search across Romaji, English, Kanji, and aliases.
  - Query Params:
    - `q` (string, required): Search query (e.g. `titan`, `solo`, `frieren`)
    - `limit` (number, optional, default: `10`)
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/search?q=titan"`
- **`GET /api/v1/filter`**
  - Description: Multi-criteria filter across genres, format, and broadcast year.
  - Query Params:
    - `genre` (string, e.g. `action`, `fantasy`, `sci-fi`)
    - `year` (number, e.g. `2024`)
    - `format` (string, e.g. `TV`, `Movie`, `OVA`)
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/filter?genre=action&year=2024"`
- **`GET /api/v1/genres`**
  - Description: Master list of 34 curated anime genres with slugs and icons.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/genres`

### 7. Broadcast Schedule & Media Feeds
- **`GET /api/v1/schedule`**
  - Description: Weekly 7-day airing calendar categorized by day with localized dub availability.
  - Query Params:
    - `day` (string, optional): `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`, `sunday`.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/schedule`
- **`GET /api/v1/news`**
  - Description: Latest anime news items guaranteed to have cover images (60-day auto-purge TTL).
  - Query Params:
    - `limit` (number, optional, default: `20`)
    - `page` (number, optional, default: `1`)
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/news?limit=10"`
- **`GET /api/v1/articles`**
  - Description: Editorial analyses, reviews, and text digests without images.
  - Query Params:
    - `limit` (number, optional, default: `20`)
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/articles?limit=10"`
- **`GET /api/v1/trailers`**
  - Description: Official YouTube trailers with embed URLs and video thumbnails.
  - Query Params:
    - `limit` (number, optional, default: `20`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/trailers`

### 8. Universal Characters & Production Staff Encyclopedia
- **`GET /api/v1/characters/:idOrSlug`**
  - Description: Full character dossier with physical traits (height, age, birthday, blood type), rich Markdown bio, and voice actors across languages.
  - Path Params: `idOrSlug` (string or number, e.g. `40882` or `eren-yeager`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/characters/eren-yeager`
- **`GET /api/v1/characters/search`**
  - Description: Typo-tolerant search across 3,553+ characters.
  - Query Params: `q` (string, required)
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/characters/search?q=eren"`
- **`GET /api/v1/staff/:idOrSlug`**
  - Description: Production staff and voice actor dossier with social links, bio, and anime credits.
  - Path Params: `idOrSlug` (string or number, e.g. `95732`)
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/staff/95732`
- **`GET /api/v1/staff/search`**
  - Description: Search across 2,172+ industry creators and seiyuu.
  - Query Params: `q` (string, required)
  - Example: `curl -s "https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/staff/search?q=sawano"`
- **`GET /api/v1/series/:slug/characters`**
  - Description: Cast and character dossier for a master franchise.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/series/attack-on-titan/characters`
- **`GET /api/v1/series/:slug/staff`**
  - Description: Animation studios and key production staff for a master franchise.
  - Example: `curl -s https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1/series/attack-on-titan/staff`

---

## Instructions for AI Agents & LLMs

When writing code (Flutter, React, Svelte, Vue, Python, Node.js, Swift, Kotlin, Go) that integrates AniNexus:
1. Always use `https://ani-nexus.onrender.com/api/v1` as the base URL.
2. No authorization header or API key is required. Do not invent an `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header.
3. Handle HTTP `410 Gone` gracefully when querying awards older than 5 years.
4. To check for Hindi or English dubs, inspect `item.dubAvailability.hasHindiDub` and `item.dubAvailability.hasEnglishDub`.
5. For ratings, use `item.combinedScore` (0-100 scale) or divide by 10 for a standard 10-star rating.
